name: Jarad, Golgari Lich Lord
oracle_text:
Jarad gets +1/+1 for each creature card in your graveyard.
{1}{B}{G}, Sacrifice another creature: Each opponent loses life equal to the sacrificed creature's power.
Sacrifice a Swamp and a Forest: Return this card from your graveyard to your hand.
blocked_sentences: Sacrifice a Swamp and a Forest: Return this card from your graveyard to your hand.

needs.what: an activated-ability cost that sacrifices several permanents each matching its own selector (here one Swamp AND one Forest), payable only when every part can be met by a distinct permanent; e.g. `sacrifice` accepting a list of selectors
needs.why_existing_wont_do: The `sacrifice` cost key takes one selector plus `count` (costs.py `_sacrifice_pool`); `count: 2` with `any_of` Swamp/Forest would also accept two Swamps or two Forests, which is a different (looser) cost. The rest of the line is expressible: `active_zones: ["graveyard"]` with a `return_to_hand` of `self_only`.
